svg.title: Kashif's rotating ASCII object gallery
svg.desc: Sixteen depth-shaded ASCII sculptures assemble from scattered characters, rotate through sixteen 3D views, dissolve, and repeat. Cube, sphere, pyramid, torus, trefoil knot, Mobius strip, gyroscope, orbital atom, double helix, icosahedron, crystal, spacecraft, gear, wave field, octahedron and nested cubes.

g.text: learning by building. one dimension at a time.
